instruments.evidence_quote:
commencing in May
1998 MMR began purchasing 450,000 million British thermal units
(mmbtu) of natural gas per month (representing approximately 75
percent of Main Pass' natural gas purchases) for $2.175 per
mmbtu.
instruments.notes: Gas PURCHASE price protection contract entered by FSC in April 1998 for anticipated 1998 gas purchase requirements; 450,000 mmbtu per month (volume stated per month only, not daily or total). Fair value is for the contract as a whole (est. approx. $1.1 million loss at 12/31/1998). Filing states MMR does not hedge its principal products.

instruments.evidence_quote:
The contract also granted the
supplier the option to put 450,000 mmbtu per month to MMR at a
price of $2.175 per mmbtu during 1999.
instruments.notes: Put granted to the supplier (MMR obligated to buy 450,000 mmbtu per month at strike if exercised); part of the same contract as the fixed-price purchase, whose fair value of approx. -$1.1 million is reported on the other entry.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: MMR does not hedge or enter price protection contracts for principal products; only FSC's 1998 natural gas purchase price protection program (fixed price plus supplier put in 1999).
